summary: The test suite covers core requirements (classification logic, argument parsing, output formatting, workflow structure) with good unit test organization and end-to-end validation through act. However, critical edge cases are missing: empty secrets arrays, negative/extreme values for warning-window, invalid date formats in --now parameter, pipe characters in secret names (markdown escaping), and file I/O error handling in validate.ts. The two act test cases (mixed, healthy) exercise the happy path well but lack edge-case fixtures. Design is strong with clear separation of concerns, deterministic test dates, and proper fixture isolation, but fixture files referenced in tests are not provided and test data variety is limited. The suite would catch regressions in main flows but may miss production edge cases.
